name: event-sourcing-replay-p4
prompt: what is the safe way to rebuild a read model by replaying the stored events from scratch

chunks.content: decided to rebuild the projection by streaming the whole event log from offset zero into a fresh table, then atomically swapping it in once it catches up to the live tip
each projection handler is written to be idempotent and keyed on the event id so replaying the same event twice does not double-count anything
the compliance team can replay a user's session recording to review what actions they took during an incident
rebuilt the settings page layout with a two-column responsive grid
the rebuilder records its last processed event position every 10k events so a crash mid-replay resumes instead of starting the whole log over again
added a non-null default to the orders table behind an online migration so writes never block
the sports app lets fans scrub back and replay the last goal from multiple camera angles
outbound mail retries through a backup SMTP relay if the primary refuses the connection
when an event schema changes we keep an upcaster that translates old event versions to the current shape during replay so historical events still project correctly
for very long aggregates we periodically snapshot state so a replay can start from the latest snapshot instead of the very first event
dates in exports now follow ISO 8601 regardless of the viewer's locale
the public API caps each token at 100 requests per minute with a leaky bucket
added a dark theme toggle that persists in local storage
the product search now supports faceted filtering by brand and price range
bulk customer import accepts a CSV and validates each row before committing
